title: dg ci refs --json
description: The repository's live refs, their commits and who can see each. A member's identity reads the members-only ones too (`membersView`), by their real names and commits; a member whose key cannot read them here gets an error, never a list without them. Anyone else with an identity (a runner bot) reads the members-only branches shared with it (`sharedView`), as git lists them.

sharedView.description: Whether the members-only branches shared with this reader were read (a reader outside the members of a public repository).

shared.description: The members-only branches shared with this reader (full names), listed among the refs as members.
